sections.title: About this guide
data: Station Neah Bay is a small-boat station at the far northwest tip of Washington, about 70 road miles west of Port Angeles (public maps). The home count comes from the Coast Guard's housing map; the station facts come from the Northwest District's unit list and an undated fact sheet, read through search results.
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 13 active homes at Neah Bay.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
